packet.title: Judge the Judge
packet.introduction: We built a first draft of your judgment from your public work. It will be wrong in places. Teach us how you see it.

distinctions.name: Fear of Failure
distinctions.summary: Concern that the person cannot succeed at the thing itself.
distinctions.correction_prompt: If this is not exactly right, what distinction would you make instead?

distinctions.name: Fear of Ridicule
distinctions.summary: Concern about how other people will evaluate the person or their work.
distinctions.correction_prompt: If this is not exactly right, what distinction would you make instead?

distinctions.name: Fear of Uncertainty
distinctions.summary: Continuing to acquire information after enough exists for a reasonable move.
distinctions.correction_prompt: If this is not exactly right, what distinction would you make instead?

distinctions.name: Fear of Success
distinctions.summary: Approaching success creates concern about the identity, responsibilities, or consequences that follow.
distinctions.correction_prompt: If this is not exactly right, what distinction would you make instead?
